milestones.title: Planning adopted, records migrated, repository restructured
Core DAG orchestration and configuration schemas
F1 and F1b conformance, India wiring

phases.summary: A-01/A-02/A-03/A-05/A-08/A-09/A-11/U-05 (schema)/U-07 (field) implemented; A-12 partial (run id deterministic, no seeds recorded: no sampler exists); A-04 and Section-9 partial (technologies.yaml/experiments.yaml have no loader); A-07 partial (rasters are tiled GTiff, not true COG; parquet tables carry no schema_version); A-06 covers F1 and F2a (the ZZZ fixture; F3 has its own synthetic world); A-10 absent; A-13 partial. A-02 will record the METHODOLOGY version per phase entry (D-core-022, V15). OQ-032 closed (D-core-018). CountryParams requirement is per-phase (D-core-013); default country-run expansion still parameters.json-only, unowned.

M-F1-03/M-F1-07 closed; M-F1-04 resource channel acquired (F-3). M-F1-05 code+tests done, OQ-038 resolved (retry/timeout policy, D-F1-019), M-F1-05 ERA5 gust acquired, registered and F1b-audited for BRA/PRT/IND (D-F1-022/023, 2026-10-06; OQ-029/OQ-037 closed). M-F1-02 still fails. OQ-012/024/027/028 closed. F5-1 done: GEM trackers pinned (snapshot 2026-08-09) and clipped per country, validation-only (V-06 tests); GEM replaces GPPD for F7b (D-F1-026).

GWA products moved to real inspection. Weibull-A/k CRS gap fixed. IND parameters.json filled, F1b runs clean (0 alerts). CMIP6 resource channel (GFDL-ESM4/MIROC6) moved out of not_audited, 0 alerts, BRA/PRT/IND clean. ERA5 audited 2026-10-06 (0.25 deg, 0 alerts, BRA/PRT/IND); GEM still not_audited.

Green for PRT (93,149 px), IND (2.61M px) and BRA (7.10M px) with mainland scope, uncapped distances plus flags, per-height wind, geodesic slope, windowed reprojection, keyed clip caches. V-01 refrozen on ZZZ (G-4, then twice more for new layers). Land cover as per-class sample counts and slope as 30 m bin counts from Copernicus GLO-30 (M-F2a-06/07, D-F2a-015/016). See D-F2a-004..016.

H-4 done and wired: phase siting_layers writes 12 physical-unit layers (no normalization). Exclusions E1-E6 (H-3) blocked on Stage R; legacy suitability_criteria still registered but not in the default run (D-F2b-005).

Clean rerun of the three countries on 2026-10-08 (D-F3-009): three named land scenarios (central, restrictive, permissive) with a candidate-set stability table; IND land cover from the exact 10 m tiles (hardly different from the 100 m round). Central solar / wind eligible land PRT 23.9 / 31.7%, IND 4.9 / 17.2%, BRA 18.0 / 25.8%. Not built: the full-factorial range report. Source quality is in LIMITATIONS and OPEN_QUESTIONS (OQ-047 Tier 3 density, OQ-049 unsourced ranges, L-020), not in the run status; literature for the density, discharge and solar-slope upper ends is pending (Stage R).

J-1 to J-5 done: ensemble decided (option C, 36 members), forcing.parquet with masked cell-members (OQ-042 option C), members.yaml, hazard_context.parquet for the core window, one map per member; all wired in main.py. Open: ISIMIP3b 2071-2100 hazard data not acquired, loss functions (OQ-007).

Built and tested on the synthetic country: pure functions, CF models, IEC class rule, aggregates (all-present and like-for-like), pipeline and PhaseSpec technical_potential. BRA, PRT and IND fail loudly with MissingParameterError (9 missing items each) until OQ-004, OQ-005 and OQ-023 give values; F5 is not in run.target_phases. potential_maps writes the COG rasters and the T-R1 figure under settings.yaml figures.
Inventory input ready (D-F7b-001): GEM solar/wind per country, validation-only. No F7b code.

regression.status: V-01 refrozen 2026-10-06 (G-4): F1, F2a and E1-E3 on the ZZZ country, in-repo fixtures, no external download. Legacy PRT/BRA baseline retired.
